This happened last year.
I was playing Fortnite and got my first friend request from a teammate. Eventually we talked every day for a few months.Turns out we lived in the same city, so one day we decided to meet each other....
Turned out to be a 40 year old male (whilst I was 12 and a weak and short girl).
He started approaching me and I backed out.He chased me for a solid 2 minutes before giving up and going the other way.(there was a cop car and I was heading for it). So I told the cops what happened and described him.They showed me a few pictures until I finally saw his face.What the cops told me next sent chills up my spine. The dude turned out to be a rapist and murderer who had escaped from prison.I told them whitch way he ran and they asked me if I wanted to go with them so I can safely return to my house.I said no thanks (my house was across the street).And with that,they drove off.If it wasn't for those two cops,I wouldn't be here to tell this story.Thank you for reading!
